Discuss an itinerary Become a HI Partner Route framework Separate the fixed pattern from the local detail ROUTE The movement Destinations, nights, transfers, arrival windows, season and frequency of departure. GROUP The operating profile Likely numbers, age range, rooming, leader and driver rooms, luggage, access and dietary needs. STANDARD The service baseline Meals, meeting space, Wi-Fi, coach access, check-in process and information required for each departure. Capacity conversation Give local providers a forecast they can use The more clearly the pattern is described, the easier it is to assess suitable hostels, seasonal availability and operational constraints across the network. Dates Exact, flexible or date range; release and decision points Volume Departures per season and expected group-size range Rooms Dorm configuration, private rooms and allocations Meals Board basis, timings, packed food and dietary process Transport Coach dimensions, drop-off, parking and luggage handling Access and exceptions Step-free routes, lifts, accessible bathrooms and communication formats; specialist equipment; and late operations Provider handoff Keep the commercial and operational record aligned Confirm rates, inclusions, payment and cancellation terms with the relevant local provider or HI member association. Agree who owns rooming lists, final numbers, property information and changes before each departure. Turn the route into an actionable request Share the pattern, volume, standards and first travel window.
